title: Natural two-column cohomology image of a first-quadrant bicomplex
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], and I_a a family of commuting cochain bicomplexes indexed by Z times N [def-sp-double-complex-total], zero in negative horizontal degree. Extend the N degree by zero, totalize, and give each total a subcomplex filtration L_a whose degreewise steps are the second-filtration diagonal image sums [def-sp-filtration, def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For p in N let phi_{a,p}: L_a^p/L_a^{p+2} -> L_a^{p-1}/L_a^{p+1} be any map with the canonical quotient-projection equation. For all p,q in N there are isomorphisms image H^{p+q}(phi_{a,p}) ≅ H^p(H^q(I_a)). They are natural for all bicomplex maps f:I_a -> I_b: if s is the step-(p-1) restriction of Tot(f), and beta is the induced map L_a^{p-1}/L_a^{p+1} -> L_b^{p-1}/L_b^{p+1}, then e_a^{-1} followed by the source image inclusion and H^{p+q}(beta) equals H^p(H^q(f)) followed by e_b^{-1} and the target image inclusion. The step and quotient map are specified by their commuting inclusion and projection squares.

proof.text: Use the generic internal graded-term inclusion and projection lemmas of the row-graded-cycles module to identify the resolution-degree graded terms with the horizontal column, shifted by p. Prove compatibility with the horizontal differential directly from the total differential formula; the vertical component factors through the next step and vanishes on the quotient. Reuse the generic pullback-of-kernel, kernel-of-cokernel, and equal-kernel quotient isomorphism lemmas from SecondFiltrationRowCycleComparison; these calculations identify concrete first-page quotients with horizontal cohomology, normalized on actual horizontal cycles.

Apply the representative-normalized page differential to a horizontal cocycle. Its remaining total differential is q.negOnePow times the vertical differential. Conjugate the degree-p isomorphism by (q*p).negOnePow, then compose with the evaluation/homology comparison. Mathlib homologyIsoOfComponents gives an actual isomorphism from homology of page one to iterated cohomology. At p=0 its missing predecessor is the negative extended column, which is zero; apply the generic gradedPiece_isZero_of_complexStep_eq_bot lemma imported from SecondFiltrationRowCohomology, then use monicity of the cycle inclusion and the epic page projection.

Choose the uniquely normalized successor homology isomorphism. The generic quotient-image comparison identifies the concrete second page with image H(phi); cancellation of the epic quotient projection identifies its canonical transition with the supplied phi. The representative-epis theorem proves the normalization map is epic. Compose the inverse image comparison, inverse successor comparison, and signed component homology isomorphism. The data chosen here are determined by their displayed normalization equations.

Construct the filtered total map from the diagonal image-sum inclusions. Graded quotient components yield cycle and page maps. Differential representative covers prove these page maps commute with the differentials. Successor-cycle covers and epi cancellation give naturality of the normalized successor comparison. For the quotient-image comparison construct the actual map of cycle representatives, descend the source quotient map, and use its commuting square with phi and the supplied beta; normalized image cancellation gives naturality after the target image inclusion. The given step restriction and beta agree with these constructions by monic and epic cancellation. Naturality of total inclusions, evaluation/homology, and the sign multipliers gives the iterated-cohomology square. Combine the three squares to obtain the stated equation.

theorem secondFiltration_two_column_image
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C]
    {ι : Type uI}
    (I : ι → HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (hzero : ∀ (a : ι) (k : ℤ), k < 0 → IsZero ((I a).X k))
    (L : ∀ a : ι, DecreasingFiltration
      (HomologicalComplex₂.total
        (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat.extendFunctor C).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (I a)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ (a : ι) (p n : ℤ), (L a).complexStep p n =
      ((HomologicalComplex₂.secondFiltration
        (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat.extendFunctor C).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (I a)) n).step p))
    (φ : ∀ (a : ι) (p : ℕ),
      (L a).complexQuotient (p : ℤ) ((p : ℤ) + 2) (by omega) ⟶
        (L a).complexQuotient ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega))
    (hφ : ∀ (a : ι) (p : ℕ),
      (L a).complexQuotientπ (p : ℤ) ((p : ℤ) + 2) (by omega) ≫ φ a p =
        Subobject.ofLE ((L a).step (p : ℤ)) ((L a).step ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1))
          ((L a).antitone_step (by omega)) ≫
            (L a).complexQuotientπ ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega)) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (a : ι) (p q : ℕ),
        image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (φ a p) ((p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ))) ≅
          ((I a).homology (q : ℤ)).homology p,
      ∀ (a b : ι) (f : I a ⟶ I b) (p q : ℕ)
        (s : ((L a).step ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) : CochainComplex C ℤ) ⟶
          ((L b).step ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) : CochainComplex C ℤ))
        (β : (L a).complexQuotient ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega) ⟶
          (L b).complexQuotient ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega)),
        s ≫ ((L b).step ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1)).arrow =
          ((L a).step ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1)).arrow ≫ HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
            (((ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat.extendFunctor C).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map f) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) →
        (L a).complexQuotientπ ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega) ≫ β =
          s ≫ (L b).complexQuotientπ ((p : ℤ) - 2 + 1) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega) →
        (e a p q).inv ≫
            image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (φ a p) ((p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ))) ≫
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap β ((p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ)) =
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f (q : ℤ)) p ≫
            (e b p q).inv ≫
              image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (φ b p) ((p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ)))
